name: cloudflare
description: Cloudflare integration — list zones, manage DNS records, and purge cache through the Cloudflare API v4 using a scoped API token.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Cloudflare zones, DNS records, and cache

fields.label: API Token
fields.helpText: Create a scoped API token with the permissions you need (e.g. Zone:Read, DNS:Edit, Cache Purge).

fields.label: Default Zone ID
fields.helpText: Optional default zone id used when a tool call does not pass one.

fields.label: Account ID
fields.helpText: Optional Cloudflare account id, used by account-scoped operations.

tools.name: cloudflare.list_zones
tools.description: List the zones (domains) the API token can access.

tools.name: cloudflare.list_dns_records
tools.description: List DNS records in a zone, optionally filtered by type and name.

zoneId.description: Zone id (falls back to the configured default zone)

type.description: Filter by record type, e.g. A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX

name.description: Filter by record name, e.g. www.example.com

tools.name: cloudflare.create_dns_record
tools.description: Create a DNS record in a zone.

zoneId.description: Zone id (falls back to the configured default zone)

type.description: Record type, e.g. A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX

name.description: Record name, e.g. www.example.com or @ for the root

content.description: Record content, e.g. an IP address or target hostname

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds. 1 means automatic (default).

proxied.description: Whether the record is proxied through Cloudflare (orange cloud)

tools.name: cloudflare.update_dns_record
tools.description: Update an existing DNS record. Only the fields you pass are changed.

zoneId.description: Zone id (falls back to the configured default zone)

recordId.description: The DNS record id to update

ttl.description: New TTL in seconds. 1 means automatic.

proxied.description: Whether the record is proxied through Cloudflare

tools.name: cloudflare.delete_dns_record
tools.description: Delete a DNS record. This is not easily reversible.

zoneId.description: Zone id (falls back to the configured default zone)

recordId.description: The DNS record id to delete

tools.name: cloudflare.purge_cache
tools.description: Purge Cloudflare's cache for a zone — either everything, or a specific list of file URLs.

zoneId.description: Zone id (falls back to the configured default zone)

everything.description: Purge the entire cache for the zone

files.description: Specific file URLs to purge from cache
